heading: Claim DTAA Benefits: How to Apply for Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) using Form 42
tldr: Double Taxation Avoidance Agreements (DTAAs) are treaties between countries to prevent income from being taxed twice.
To claim DTAA benefits, Indian residents earning foreign income must obtain a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC).
Form 42 is the prescribed online application form for Indian residents to request a TRC from the Income Tax Department.
The TRC serves as official proof of your tax residency in India, essential for foreign tax authorities.
Applying for a TRC can significantly reduce your tax burden by allowing you to avail of lower tax rates or tax credits on foreign income.
caption:
Are you an Indian living abroad or earning money from another country? You might be paying too much tax! India has special agreements with many countries to make sure you don't pay tax twice on the same income. To use these benefits, you need a special certificate from the Indian tax department. Our new article explains exactly how to get this important certificate using a simple online form. Read on to save your hard-earned money!
